prime_agent_v0_7_0_getapikeyenvvars_reso.content:
Repo: /home/bench/work/repo (prime-agent v0.7.0).

STRUCTURE of `getApiKeyEnvVars(provider)` in packages/ai/src/env-api-keys.ts — exactly three sources, in order:
1. early special case: provider === "github-copilot" -> ["COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN", "GH_TOKEN", "GITHUB_TOKEN"]
2. early special case: provider === "anthropic" -> ["ANTHROPIC_OAUTH_TOKEN", "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"]
3. flat `envMap` object lookup: returns [envVar] if present, else undefined.
Only the two special cases return multi-element arrays. Hyphenated provider keys are quoted in envMap. Env var names need not match provider names, and the same env var may repeat across providers.

SCOPING CAVEAT: AWS_* variables and GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS / ADC logic live in `getEnvApiKey` and `hasVertexAdcCredentials`, NOT in `getApiKeyEnvVars`. Do not include them in getApiKeyEnvVars results.
